name: Hibarino Yomi
source:
Mysterious young man who even uses honorifics for plants. He follows around his childhood friend [url=/c85109]Juurou[/url], who he helps when he gets tired of his duties and hero activities. A member of the Icarus squadron, but is mostly active as the commander as he cannot transform into Icarus.

[Based on the [url=https://adeltaz1.wixsite.com/uuultrac/blank-12]official description[/url]] 

[spoiler]Birthplace: Planet Babel, M33 Triangulum constellation, Milky Way. 
Real age: 333 human years.[/spoiler] 

[Based on the in-game profile]
